data.name: Ozo
data.gender_notes: Ozo is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Yoruba language, Ozo is a name of great power and strength. In Nigerian culture, Ozo is the title given to the traditional ruler or elder, representing wisdom, authority, and respect. The name Ozo carries the meaning “Strength, Power” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ozo usually hope their child will grow to embody strength, power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner strength and courage of an individual, inspiring them to lead with wisdom and authority.
data.etymology: Ozo belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strength, Power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ozo total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: אוזו
in_hebrew.meaning: אוזו משמעותו חוזק או יכולת בעברית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אוזו הוא שם שמשמעותו חוזק או יכולת בעברית, קשור לשורש עוז אשר מופיע בתנך כחוזק וכעוצמה רוחנית. השם עשוי להיות קשור למושג החוזק הנפשי או הרוחני, והוא עשוי לשמש כתיאור לאדם בעל אופי חזק או דמות רוחנית משמעותית.

in_greek.name: Όζω
in_greek.meaning: Όζω σημαίνει δύναμη ή ικανότητα στα Ελληνικά
in_greek.long_meaning: Όζω είναι ένα όνομα που σημαίνει δύναμη ή ικανότητα στα Ελληνικά. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος συνδέεται με τη λέξη 'όζος', που σημαίνει δύναμη ή σθένος. Στην πνευματική και πολιτιστική παράδοση, το όνομα Όζω μπορεί να συμβολίζει τη δύναμη του χαρακτήρα ή την πνευματική αντοχή.

in_latin.name: Ozo
in_latin.meaning: Ozo means strength or ability in Latin
in_latin.long_meaning: Ozo is a name that means strength or ability in Latin. The etymology of the name is connected to the concept of strength or power, which was highly valued in ancient Roman and Christian cultures. The name Ozo may signify a person of strong character or spiritual resilience.

in_english.name: Ozo
in_english.meaning: Ozo means strength, ability, or power in English
in_english.long_meaning: Ozo is a Christian name that means strength, ability, or power. The name is derived from Hebrew and Greek roots, conveying the idea of physical or spiritual strength. Historically, the name may be associated with biblical concepts of inner strength and resilience. In Christian tradition, Ozo symbolizes a person of strong faith, character, and spiritual fortitude. The name is not commonly found in traditional Christian onomastics but represents a unique and meaningful choice for parents seeking a name that embodies strength and spiritual depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ozo signifies respect and reverence in Yoruba culture. It is a title borne by traditional rulers and elders who are seen as custodians of community values and wise decision-makers. The name carries the weight of authority and responsibility, and anyone bearing it is expected to live up to these expectations.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Ozo symbolizes God's wisdom and guidance. In the Yoruba faith, Ohu Meji (the two godheads), Obbatala and Ogun, are believed to bestow the Ozo title upon deserving individuals. Thus, having the name Ozo is a reminder of the divine blessings and guidance one receives from the Creator. Additionally, Ozo is also a patron saint of learning and knowledge in the Catholic Church, further emphasizing its spiritual significance.
